title: Zaporizhzhia region provides UAH 105M worth of military equipment to Ukrainian forces in October
summary: The Zaporizhzhia region provided the Ukrainian Defense Forces with military equipment worth more than UAH 105 million in October, with 45 units receiving assistance.

title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,500 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 2, 2026, have reached approximately 1,592,770 personnel, including 2,500 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

title: Air defenses down 154 out of 193 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine since evening
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 154 out of the 193 drones used by Russian troops to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 1.

title: Ukrainian, Canadian foreign ministers discuss G20 meeting outcomes, steps toward de-escalation of war
summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha described as productive a phone call he held with his Canadian counterpart, Anita Anand, on November 1.

title: Ukrainian Navy destroys six Russian aircraft, ten multiple launch rocket systems in October
summary: The Ukrainian Navy destroyed six Russian aircraft and ten multiple launch rocket systems (MLRS) in October.

title: Ukraine's territorial integrity is in Türkiye's long-term interests – expert
summary: Ukraine's stability and territorial integrity are in Türkiye's long-term interests, as they directly affect its policy in the Black Sea region and the Turkic world.

title: Lubinets announces end of ceasefire in Oleshky
summary: The ceasefire that had been in effect from October 27 to November 1 in the area around the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky, Kherson region, to allow a humanitarian operation, has ended.

title: Russian athletes have no place in Finland if Moscow continues war, Foreign Minister says
summary: Finnish Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen has said that Russian athletes will have no place in Finland next year if their country continues its war against Ukraine.

title: Hackers breach Russia's statistics agency, obtain data on Russian losses in Ukraine
summary: Belarusian hacktivist group Cyber Partisans, together with the hacker group Silent Crow, have claimed responsibility for breaching the internal IT infrastructure of Russia's Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat).

title: Ukrainian Film Festival kicks off in Poland on Nov 2, with 50 films to be screened in 12 cities
summary: The 11th Ukrainian Film Festival will take place in Poland, featuring 50 films. Screenings are scheduled in 12 cities, with two new venues joining the festival this year – Bielsko-Biala and Zielona Gora.

title: Russian SRG activity along Ukraine’s northern border drops significantly – military spox
summary: The activity of Russian sabotage and reconnaissance groups (SRG) along Ukraine’s northern border has decreased significantly.

title: Ukrainian judoka Savytskyi wins bronze at Grand Slam in UAE
summary: The latest 2026 Grand Slam tournament was held in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, with 11 Ukrainian judokas competing.
